description: This file defines the SpyHashStateImpl class, a testing utility implementing the HashState API for accumulating input bytes and comparing hash representations, primarily used for testing AbslHashValue overloads within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: SpyHashStateImpl
classes.description: A template class implementing HashState for testing, accumulating input bytes, comparing hash representations, and handling move semantics.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines multiple hash state objects or values into a new hash state, used for testing hash combination logic.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality of two hash state objects based on their internal representations.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality of two hash state objects.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two hash states to determine if they are equal or if one is a suffix of the other.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns an error message if the hash state is invalid or has been moved from.

methods.name: combine_contiguous
methods.description: Adds raw byte data to the hash state from a contiguous memory block.

methods.name: RunCombineUnordered
methods.description: Combines hash states in an unordered manner, useful for testing.

methods.name: SetDirectAbslHashValueError
methods.description: Sets an internal flag to simulate an error when AbslHashValue is called directly.
